profile.name: Yash Thapliyal
recommendations: Robert Sandor “Yash was a student of mine at Foothill College. He was a superb student and did extremely well with Amazon Web Services. He always submitted assignments on time and contributed to the class conversations around the implementation of AWS infrastructure. I know Yash will do extremely well in both his academic and occupational pursuits.”

organizations.title: Project Empower
organizations.description: Leading 20+ chapters, leveraging CS and managerial skills to guide nonprofit using coding to solve problems in underprivileged communities. Previously founded and grew a chapter to 80+ members, establishing it as the largest known chapter in Project Empower's history.

honors_and_awards.title: 2nd Place @ Lockheed Martin Code Quest 2023
honors_and_awards.description: Challenges students around the world to solve real-world problems using programming and computer science skills. Participants are given a set of coding challenges to complete within a limited time frame and are ranked by how many problems they can solve. Local Rank: 2nd Place National Rank: 13/622 - placed in the top 2% of participants nationwide
